gate.title: Before you go on
gate.intro: To use PrediGol we need your answer to each of these points, one by one.
gate.textChanged: The text changed while you were reading it: look at the new version and tick the boxes again.
gate.profile: See my data and my requests

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.help: What you accepted and when, a copy of your data and your requests about it.
privacy.outdated: You accepted an earlier version: you will be asked to accept the new one.
privacy.withdrawConfirm: If you withdraw your authorisation to process your data, you cannot use PrediGol until you give it again. Your data is not deleted by this: to delete it, ask for deletion below.
privacy.exportHelp: A file with everything PrediGol keeps about you: your account, your sessions and sign-ins, your consents, your requests and what you saved. Up to 3 times a day.
privacy.requestsHelp: We answer queries within 10 business days at most, and claims and deletion within 15. The deadline is shown here.

kind.privacy_claim: A claim: correct or update my data

privacy.deletionWarning: Deleting your data closes your account: it is anonymised and only what the law requires us to keep is kept, without identifying you. Confirm it with your password.
privacy.sent: Request sent. We answer by {date} at the latest.
privacy.optional: Optional: you change it under Notifications.

admin.title: Privacy requests
admin.help: Queries: 10 business days (extendable by 5). Claims and deletion: 15 (extendable by 8). One extension only, saying in the answer why and until when.
admin.answerPlaceholder: Your answer to the data subject
